item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.8.0

  • Unbelievable Cat is now Unbelievable Jungle — and your pet can be a cat, a dog or a monkey. Your cat comes with you: its name, how well it knows you, its office and its polaroids.
  • This is the last version of Unbelievable Cat. It keeps working as it is, and a menu item takes you to Unbelievable Jungle whenever you are ready.
  • If Unbelievable Cat opens when you log in, Unbelievable Jungle will too.

item.title: Version 1.7.1
item.description:
What's new in 1.7.1

  • Here, Kitty Kitty: one button calls every cat in your office over to your screen at once. Each cat still decides for itself — a sleeping or hungry one stays put.
  • With more than one display you can now keep the cat, its bowl and its litter box on the screen you choose, or let it roam them all.
  • Visiting cats now go home by themselves after a few minutes, and straight away if they need a litter box, rather than moving in.
  • Getting ready for Unbelievable Jungle: this version keeps a copy of your cat where the new app will be able to find it, so your cat, its bond and its office can come with you. Nothing leaves your Mac.

item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.7.0

  • Office: cats can now wander between the screens of everybody who shares a join code. You make your own room, you share the code, and nobody who does not have it can find it — there is no list to browse.
  • Your cat walks off the side of your screen and turns up on somebody else's, then comes home with whatever happened to it — fed, brushed, made a fuss of.
  • A visiting cat is a guest: it walks, climbs your windows and eats what you put down, but it never pranks, never uses the camera, never touches your windows and learns nothing about you.
  • You choose how many visitors your screen will show, up to 32, and whether your own cat may go out at all.
  • A cat can never be lost: whatever the network does, it always ends up back on your own floor.
  • The Touch Bar cat now gets the whole bar, with its mood, what it is up to, its needs and the buttons you press most.

item.title: Version 1.6.1
item.description:
What's new in 1.6.1

  • Turning on the window prank now explains the Accessibility permission before macOS asks, so you no longer get two dialogs at once.
  • Settings shows whether Accessibility permission is actually granted, with a button that opens the right pane — and it updates the moment you grant it.
  • The menu says "needs permission" while the prank cannot work, instead of sitting there switched on and silently doing nothing.

item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.6.0

  • The cat now roams every display, stepping onto whatever floor each screen has
  • New prank, off by default: it minimises the window you are working in, gloats, and gives it straight back

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.5.0

  • The cat says good morning when you sit down, and learns which hours you are usually at the Mac
  • It mentions the hour when you are up late by your own standards, and suggests a break after a long stretch
  • Looking after it builds a bond over five levels, shown in Cat Home with the days you have been together
  • Leave it alone for a couple of days and it sulks until you win it back

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.4.0

  • The cat pulls four new pranks: hanging off the menu bar, peeking over a window, pushing a mug off a title bar, and walking over your keyboard
  • In the Touch Bar the cat now walks its own lane, back and forth
  • A live viewfinder shows the shot while the cat counts down, so the camera is never on without you seeing it
  • The cat reads the room: on a video call it goes quiet, it climbs more in a browser and stays on the desk while you code
  • Low Power Mode calms the cat down
  • Do Something Silly added to the menus

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.3.0

  • The cat now speaks English, Turkish or Bulgarian — everything it says is translated
  • It tells jokes, with a setup and a punchline, in all three languages
  • Photo timing is a range you choose rather than one fixed average
  • On Macs with a Touch Bar the cat sits in the Control Strip, with need bars and quick buttons when you tap it
  • Tell Me a Joke and Take a Photo added to the menus

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.2.0

  • Personalities: sleepy, playful, clingy, shy, mischievous or chatty, with a default temperament per breed
  • Laser pointer: a red dot follows your cursor and the cat goes after it
  • Accessories now work on the illustrated breeds too, not just the Classic cat
  • The cat photographer: it pulls out a camera, counts down and takes a polaroid of you, collected in a Selfie Diary (off by default)
  • The Turkish Angora's sleeping frames were drawn facing the wrong way; fixed

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.1.0

  • Seven cats: Classic plus six illustrated breeds (Ginger, Turkish Van, Turkish Angora, British Shorthair, Siamese, Black Cat)
  • Personalities: sleepy, playful, clingy, shy, mischievous or chatty, with a default per breed
  • Sims-style needs with a mood diamond and thought bubbles
  • Water bowl and litter box you can drag anywhere
  • The cat climbs your windows and teases the close button
  • Automatic updates
